question: Which of the following is an example of greenhouse gas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbon dioxide**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Carbon dioxide is an example of greenhouse gas.
 
• Carbon dioxide (CO2) is an important trace gas in Earth's atmosphere.
 
• It is an integral part of the carbon cycle, a biogeochemical cycle in which carbon is exchanged between the Earth's oceans, soil, rocks and the biosphere. CO2 absorbs and emits infrared radiation at wavelengths of 4.26 µm and 14.99 µm and c
